mission sunday (missio) – there will be a second collection today to support the missions worldwide. thank you for your generous support. ardfert group – open public meeting at the grove, ardfert on wednesday 28 october at 8.30 pm. all welcome. refreshments provided. (see posters) parish offering/dues envelopes can be posted securely through the letterbox of the parish office. please note: cheques should be made payable to ardfert parish or to ardfert-kilmoyley capital fund . thank you, parish finance council. october – a month of prayer for priestly vocations (see leaflets and posters) world mission sunday – 18 october 2026 . world mission sunday, which is celebrated on the second last sunday of october each year, is the one sunday of the year when the entire global church comes together in support of mission. it is the holy father’s annual appeal for spiritual and financial support so that the life giving work of overseas mission and missionaries can continue. mission sunday collections will take place in every single parish worldwide. i t is a moment of universal solidarity when each member of the church family, regardless of location or background, plays their part in supporting each other. the irish cancer society - volunteer drivers needed in kerry . we are seeking compassionate volunteer drivers to join our transport team. for de tails please contact monica or emily at
